thaumicenergistics.research_page.TEGOLEM:
As communicating with the network takes power, you retro-fitted a charger to draw power from two embedded Nitor. When charged the backpack will be able to transmit for only a short time before starting another charge cycle. During this window of opportunity the golem will be able to interact with the network.
To link the backpack with your network, place it in the link slot of a wireless access point.As you progress with your golemancy research, check back here for potential new uses of the backpack.
